name: studio-parallel-content-intelligence
description: Internal Studio Parallel Instagram content intelligence application

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @studio-parallel/domain && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/config && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/observability && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/db && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/queue
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/worker && npm run build -w @studio-parallel/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --names web,worker --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/web" "npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/worker"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @studio-parallel/worker
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @studio-parallel/config && npm run seed -w @studio-parallel/db
scripts.queue:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run migrate -w @studio-parallel/queue
scripts.security:supply-chain: npm run security:workflows && npm run security:direct-dependencies && npm run security:exceptions && npm run security:sbom
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate:local: npm run check && npm run security:dependencies && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:supply-chain && npm run test:db:integration && npm run test:e2e
